title: Content-Security-Policy without base-uri
description: The Content-Security-Policy header does not restrict base-uri. This directive has no default-src fallback in CSP, so the restriction must be stated on its own to take effect.
remediation: Add base-uri to the policy with a restrictive source list (base-uri 'none' or base-uri 'self').
limitation: Header check: it also fires when no Content-Security-Policy header is sent. DPK-DAST-002 reports that case. The check cannot see a policy delivered by a meta element.
